headline: Titans CEO apologizes to fans, supports Robert Saleh, GM
summary: Titans CEO Burke Nihill said the organization believes that coach Robert Saleh and GM Mike Borgonzi are "ultimately going to get this team out of the woods."

headline: KC Concepcion on Minkah Fitzpatrick's hit: It was a football play; it wasn't dirty
summary: Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick's hit on KC Concepcion on Sunday knocked out the Browns wide receiver.

headline: Chris Olave returns to practice, listed as questionable for Sunday
summary: Saints wide receiver Chris Olave was back on the practice field Friday, but his status for Sunday's road game against the Giants remains up in the air.

headline: Bills WR DJ Moore, DL Ed Oliver are questionable
summary: The Bills did not rule anyone out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid probe
summary: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.
